title: Amelia says an angel took her to see God and names a rabbi and the Dalai Lama as teachers

tellings.quote: she said she said an angel has taken her to see God she said Gods once or twice um uh in in one point I think she talked about the doy Lama as well

plain: A person named Amelia, one of those in a documentary about nonspeaking people said to communicate by telepathy, says an angel took her to see God "once or twice." She also names a rabbi and the Dalai Lama as her teachers. The filmmaker Ky Dickens relays this from what Amelia told her.
